note: Evidence-informed authoring hints: experience dimension → AV motifs. Metaphorical, non-diagnostic. Values are safe-by-default and should be clamped at runtime.

hyperarousal.notes: Tonic readiness/tension. Prefer persistent, low-amplitude texture + gentle dynamic control. Avoid dramatic motion or contrast.

warnings: Metaphor only — not a diagnostic or clinical simulation.
Provide Stop / Safe Mode / Reduced Motion.
Avoid flashes/flicker and sudden loud sounds; keep everything user-controllable.

reduced_motion.note: Reduced Motion should remove time-based feedback/jitter and keep a calmer, mostly static overlay.

behaviors: **Flicker, strobe, rapid luminance modulation**: not needed for tonic hyperarousal and increases seizure risk; violates accessibility expectations. citeturn10search0turn10search2

**Sudden loud transients / jump-cut audio spikes**: would conflate hyperarousal with startle-induction; startle is a defensive reflex to sudden stimuli and can be distressing. citeturn10search3turn13search6
Replace any “jitter” with **slow envelope** changes (<0.2 Hz) or static texture + intensity slider. citeturn11search10turn10search5

hypervigilance.notes: Attentional scanning/threat monitoring. Use subtle narrowing and cue sensitivity without jump scares.

warnings: Metaphor only — not a diagnostic or clinical simulation.

behaviors: **Jump scares / abrupt cuts**: directly violate the repo safety note and are not necessary to represent vigilance/maintenance. citeturn46view0turn11search10
**Fast scanning camera motion** (pan/tilt, parallax): may cause vestibular discomfort and suggests “cinematic scanning” more than attention science. citeturn11search10turn11search7
Replace moving focus windows with **static composition + micro-contrast cueing** (slow fades) and allow user to disable all cueing (“Reduced Surprise”). citeturn11search10turn10search5

panic_peaks.notes: Phasic rise/fall alarm waves. Use clamped envelopes and smooth returns to baseline. No flashes, no loud transients.

Replace motion-heavy “swells” with **static imagery + slow luminance/contrast envelope** and offer a prominent Reduced Motion toggle. citeturn11search10turn10search5
